world: The assistant tracks vendor qualification and product eligibility for municipal procurement programs.

m_c5de: VeloTech Mobility maintains a $200,000 spare parts inventory and a 24-month warranty for the Velo-X1, meeting the $150,000 inventory threshold and 12-month warranty requirement under the policy.
m_3f2d: VeloTech Mobility satisfies post-purchase maintenance benchmarks for the Velo-X1, fulfilling the condition for commercial deployment authorization.
m_c4d7: VeloTech Mobility holds commercial deployment authorization and an audit showing zero critical defects for the Velo-X1, establishing compliance with municipal protection norms.
m_5302: VeloTech Mobility establishes compliance with municipal protection norms and maintains $5,000,000 in general liability protection for the Velo-X1, satisfying the civic transit listing threshold of $2,000,000.
m_4b85: VeloTech Mobility is approved for civic transit listings for the Velo-X1, qualifying for enrollment in municipal purchasing channels.
m_280b: Apex Medical Supplies holds ISO 13485 certification, satisfying quality system criteria for healthcare manufacturers.
